final: SELECT AVG(group_pressratio_avg) as avg_compression_ratio, AVG(group_gbsize_per_min_avg) as avg_size_per_minute FROM (SELECT s.zoneref, sites.typesite, AVG(s.pressratio) as group_pressratio_avg, AVG(CASE WHEN s.spanmin IS NOT NULL AND s.spanmin != 0 THEN s.gbsize / s.spanmin END) as group_gbsize_per_min_avg FROM scans s INNER JOIN sites ON s.zoneref = sites.zoneregistry WHERE s.chronotag > '2024-06-06 11:53:59.684274' AND s.chronotag < '2024-11-03 19:51:13.516797' GROUP BY s.zoneref, sites.typesite)
